equations.boundary: independently specified absorbing exports carry the actual donor rain/snow label; no N reset in the reference
equations.constant_parent: M(t)=M0+t*(incoming-outgoing) for fixed rates, with no negative parent permitted
equations.coupling: all directed legs evaluated simultaneously; no collapse to net compartment changes; explicit RK4 stages sample the evolving donor at their stage time
equations.empty: X=0 at M=0. Nonzero physical outflow from an empty donor is refused. Kinetic zero outflow needs no ratio. Exact single-flow depletion uses its continuous limiting IC composition only at the endpoint.
equations.kinetic: F_c,d=k_c,d*M_c(t); M and X evolve using their independently assembled conservative generator, including separate absorbing exterior rain/snow reservoirs
equations.negative: no physical composition inferred at M<0. Separate declared numerical examples orient signed flows that touch negative compartments; positive-target parts stay zero there and withheld inflow is recorded. They are not positive provenance references.
equations.pool: declared diagnostic coarse rule: (M_c+dt*in_c)*psi_c-sum_d(dt*F_d,c*psi_d)=X_i,c(0); same independent np.linalg.solve diagnostic at 1/4/16/64; not the reference
equations.positive: M_c>0; f_i,c=X_i,c/M_c; each nonnegative directed F_c,d removes F*f_i,c from c and adds it to d simultaneously
equations.reset: isolate sedimentation by replacing only rain/snow outgoing composition with local N share; rates and parent trajectory unchanged; pool comparison is separate

mutations.opposing_net_zero: erase equal opposing activity while leaving every parent compartment unchanged
mutations.other_cases: origin_a/b/c cyclic origin permutation at nonzero samples, with all source overlays invariant
mutations.rain_snow_sedimentation: isolated N reset of rain/snow donor fractions for partition tags, simultaneously integrated with the same exact parent rates; compare rain/snow label ownership and exports
mutations.single_transfer: wrong recipient initial share is used on the actual N->R accepted amount; same IC, parent, rates, geometry, boundary and source overlays
mutations.three_compartment_cycle: replace origin_a/b/c by a cyclic origin permutation at nonzero samples; declared closed-origin corruption, not a wrong-donor kernel claim

norms.L1: sum_cell(abs(delta_X_i))*native amount / sum_cell(abs(Xref_i)); density exports use native thickness
norms.absolute: sum_cell(abs(delta_X_i)); beside relative and max-specific errors
norms.audit: per-tag cumulative signed endpoint difference and sum over accepted synthetic interval abs(delta audit) separately; never sum tags as proof; normalize to positive gross transfer and actual rain/snow/paired tag precipitation only if denominator exists
norms.closure: signed R per compartment; per-compartment gross sum abs(R_c); gross of sum abs(sum_c R_c); overlays never enter partition
norms.compartment: each tag and N/R/S separately, same native weighting, absolute/relative/max and parent+compartment scales; reused numbers here are engineering fixture checks only
norms.process_companion: absolute weighted label mismatch and max share error; transfer Q and donor+recipient leg activity 2Q separately
norms.process_weighted: sum_e,t(A_e,t*abs(f_candidate-f_reference))/sum_e,t(A_e,t), A nonnegative integrated native applied transfer amount; zero activity explicitly NOT APPLICABLE
norms.small: tag system inventory fraction <.01: absolute <=2e-4*parent system amount replaces both relative tests; source overlays excluded from partition

reference.floor: reference selected support is RK4 rung64 measured in each applicable same norm plus 128*eps64 arithmetic bound; finest is not assumed true; if any applicable floor fails .25 budget, reference ineligible
reference.independent_check: separately assembled RK4 differential equations at every 1/4/16/64 substep rung, measured against the closed form or independent exponential; every rung retained
reference.one_way: closed-form constant-composition transfer including exact depletion
reference.other_cases: independent high-precision scaled Taylor matrix exponential, 96 terms per scaled interval, including cumulative native edge integrals; no production helper
reference.precision: Float64 exported arrays; longdouble exponential accumulation; no dependency installation
